title: The Silent Killer Hiding Inside Your Pillow Every Night
hook: Your pillow doubles in weight over two years—not from fluff, but from dead skin mites and their droppings.

why_this_can_go_viral: Combines physical reaction with invisible threat—intriguing and alarming.

hook: Lake Kivu holds dissolved methane and carbon dioxide—if disturbed, it could release a gas cloud that suffocates millions.

title: The Glitch Where Your Own Cells Attack Your Eyes—Suddenly

title: The Sound That Breaks Glass—And Your Eardrums Too
